tables._migration: DEFINE TABLE _migration TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.refresh_token: DEFINE TABLE refresh_token TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE
tables.user: DEFINE TABLE user TYPE NORMAL SCHEMAFULL PERMISSIONS NONE

fields.applied_at: DEFINE FIELD applied_at ON _migration TYPE datetime PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.checksum: DEFINE FIELD checksum ON _migration TYPE string PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.name: DEFINE FIELD name ON _migration TYPE string PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.version: DEFINE FIELD version ON _migration TYPE string PERMISSIONS FULL

indexes.migration_version: DEFINE INDEX migration_version ON _migration FIELDS version UNIQUE

fields.expires_at: DEFINE FIELD expires_at ON refresh_token TYPE datetime PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.replaced_by: DEFINE FIELD replaced_by ON refresh_token TYPE none | record<refresh_token> PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.revoked_at: DEFINE FIELD revoked_at ON refresh_token TYPE none | datetime PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.token_hash: DEFINE FIELD token_hash ON refresh_token TYPE string PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.user: DEFINE FIELD user ON refresh_token TYPE record<user> PERMISSIONS FULL

indexes.refresh_token_expires_at: DEFINE INDEX refresh_token_expires_at ON refresh_token FIELDS expires_at
indexes.refresh_token_hash: DEFINE INDEX refresh_token_hash ON refresh_token FIELDS token_hash UNIQUE
indexes.refresh_token_user: DEFINE INDEX refresh_token_user ON refresh_token FIELDS user

fields.disabled: DEFINE FIELD disabled ON user TYPE bool PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.must_change_password: DEFINE FIELD must_change_password ON user TYPE bool PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.password_hash: DEFINE FIELD password_hash ON user TYPE string PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.prefs: DEFINE FIELD prefs ON user TYPE object PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.prefs.accent: DEFINE FIELD prefs.accent ON user TYPE 'US' | 'UK' PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.prefs.locale: DEFINE FIELD prefs.locale ON user TYPE string PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.prefs.theme: DEFINE FIELD prefs.theme ON user TYPE 'system' | 'light' | 'dark' PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.role: DEFINE FIELD role ON user TYPE 'admin' | 'user' PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.source_lang: DEFINE FIELD source_lang ON user TYPE string PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.target_lang: DEFINE FIELD target_lang ON user TYPE string PERMISSIONS FULL
fields.username: DEFINE FIELD username ON user TYPE string PERMISSIONS FULL

indexes.user_role: DEFINE INDEX user_role ON user FIELDS role
indexes.user_username: DEFINE INDEX user_username ON user FIELDS username UNIQUE
